description: This file defines the LockFileValidator class, which implements event-driven validation for the integrity of the composer.lock file during package management operations in Drupal. It includes methods for hashing, storing, validating, and deleting lock file hashes, and subscribes to various package manager events.

classes.name: LockFileValidator
classes.description: A final class implementing event subscription to validate the integrity of the composer.lock file during package management operations in Drupal.

methods.name: getHash
methods.description: Returns the XXH64 hash of a file, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: storeHash
methods.description: Stores the hash of the active lock file in key-value storage.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the lock file has not changed unexpectedly during stage operations.

methods.name: deleteHash
methods.description: Deletes the stored lock file hash from key-value storage.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping package manager events to class methods for handling lock file validation.
